role: bounded integration of original forecast-indexed ordered target channels; component checks followed by 24 development pilots
registration_context: library/objective preflight passed; 154 original candidates decoded, 74022 forecast visibility checks passed, 12 boundary slots covered via three cached and nine newly obtained slots; dynamic controller outcomes remain unobserved
unchanged: original asset, initial stock, seed, 154-candidate roster, announcement contract, admission rules, scalar brackets, tolerances, safety fallback, event order, physical engine, denominators and negative evidence

target_interface.supported_inputs: retain a static ordered two-unit fraction vector; add an ordered (eligible nomination decisions,2) fraction array on the existing target_fractions input
target_interface.selection: at decision minute t, select row t//30 for that decision before nomination; static vectors remain constant over decisions
target_interface.eligible_rows: 338 rows for execution horizon 10200; last eligible decision 10110, delivery 10170. No post-horizon targets are queried
target_interface.signal: reuse 2022-only fit and decoded 1000-node integer channels; actual delivery t+60 and previous half-hour forecasts must both be published by actual decision UTC
target_interface.observability: record selected ordered target fractions in nomination metadata; forecasts alone determine them. Prices, later announcements, realized demand and saved outcomes do not enter targets

components.fixture: 240-minute execution with inactive delivery clocks 0/60, export at120 and import at180; identical announced contract, half-full initial inventory and zero locked PN
components.constant_equivalence: two retained constant pairs each run once as a static vector and once as six identical ordered rows; compare PN, admissions, delivered flow, stocks and failure accounting after excluding new target metadata
components.functional_routing: both selected functional pairs run once on six explicit fixture stresses [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1,0.25]; record per-decision targets and retain physical/service failures
components.tests: separate channels reach correct units at correct nomination clocks, constant schedule equivalence, no unused terminal row, historic forecast publication cutoff, absolute settlement-clock economics and censored cost on failed/partial paths; count any actual policy/trajectory calls separately
components.gate: constant equivalence, target routing, visibility and accounting must pass before pilots. Functional nonfulfillment is an observed performance result, not an interface failure

pilots.selection: first original functional pair and its already registered swapped partner; structural selection, no outcome-based selection
pilots.window_selection: original first and last windows in each sample; last window exercises the repaired boundary without changing source request marks
pilots.execution: execute all 24 registered cells, preserving physical interruptions, service failures, planning failures and unassessed requests; no retuning or replacement profiles after observing results
pilots.economics: exact gross import/export at actual executed half-hour MID plus inherited terminal inventory adjustment. Full cost is defined only for successful complete windows; failed/interrupted windows retain null full-window cost
pilots.storage: compact run summaries, hourly records, nominations and first failure context; no full-minute week traces or checkpoints

decision: if interfaces and accounting agree, retain all 24 outcomes and freeze the next population experiment with explicit execution budget before any matrix launch. A pilot success is not a 95-percent reliability pass. If an implementation discrepancy occurs, retain the initial result and count repaired reruns; scientific failures remain results
limitations: two structurally selected functional pairs, six heavily overlapping source windows, analyst-defined notices and reset stocks, MID-indexed simulation costs; no source effect, population reliability, actual BM profits, independent confirmation or OR submission-readiness inference
